sections.title: Talking about time
sections.content:
Advanced ways to discuss time and duration:
• in the meantime — during the time between two events. The results will be ready next week. In the meantime, rest.
• for the time being — temporarily, for now. We'll use this office for the time being.
• sooner or later — eventually, at some point. Sooner or later, the truth will come out.
• at the eleventh hour — at the last possible moment. The deal was saved at the eleventh hour.
• round the clock — all day and night. Doctors worked round the clock to save patients.

sections.title: Duration and frequency
sections.content:
Expressing how long and how often:
• intermittent — not continuous; stopping and starting. We had intermittent rain throughout the day.
• prolonged — continuing for a long time. Prolonged stress can damage your health.
• sporadic — occurring at irregular intervals. There were sporadic outbreaks of violence.
• transient — lasting only a short time. Fame can be transient in the entertainment industry.
• concurrent — happening at the same time. She managed three concurrent projects successfully.

exercises.question: Something that lasts only a short time is:
exercises.explanation: Transient means lasting only for a short time; not permanent.

exercises.question: Working 24 hours a day is working:
exercises.explanation: Round the clock means all day and all night without stopping.

exercises.question: Something that stops and starts repeatedly is:
exercises.explanation: Intermittent means occurring at irregular intervals; not continuous.

exercises.question: Happening at the very last possible moment is:
exercises.explanation: At the eleventh hour means at the last possible moment.

exercises.question: Events happening at the same time are:
exercises.explanation: Concurrent means existing, happening, or done at the same time.

exercises.question: 'For the time being' means:
exercises.explanation: For the time being means temporarily; until some other arrangement is made.

exercises.question: Something that continues for a very long time is:
exercises.explanation: Prolonged means continuing for a long time or longer than usual.

exercises.question: Events occurring at irregular, unpredictable intervals are:
exercises.explanation: Sporadic means occurring at irregular intervals or only in a few places.
